description: This file contains a serializer codec for well-known StringComparer types within the Orleans.Serialization framework. It includes implementations for reading and writing StringComparer objects, as well as serializers for EqualityComparer and Comparer for use in serialization contexts.

classes.name: WellKnownStringComparerCodec
classes.description: Serializer for well-known StringComparer types, handling their serialization and deserialization based on their type and compare options.

classes.name: EqualityComparerBaseCodec
classes.description: Serializer for EqualityComparer<T> used in serialization context, with minimal implementation.

classes.name: ComparerBaseCodec
classes.description: Serializer for Comparer<T> used in serialization context, with minimal implementation.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Checks if the provided type is supported for serialization, including known internal types and any implementing IEqualityComparer<string>.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a StringComparer object from the binary reader based on stored type info.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a StringComparer or EqualityComparer into the binary writer, including its type and options.
